highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.1 delivers two upstream m150 fixes for text allocation safety and stencil render-pass bounds.

bullets.detail: Includes the upstream SubRunAllocator use-after-free fix for safer text rendering.
Checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area to avoid incorrect stencil behavior.
